text: That evening: Holmes says the bed was clamped to the floor
why: Holmes says this at the Crown Inn in the gathering darkness on the day of the visit (¶196, ¶214).

text: Why was the bed in the middle room clamped to the floor?
why: Holmes has just pointed out the clamped bed as peculiar, so the question arises naturally and does not point at an answer.

text: Why was the bed in the middle room clamped to the floor? — a practical reason of the household, with no bearing on the case
id: q.why_bed_clamped=a practical reason of the household, with no bearing on the case
why: A neutral, innocent possibility a reader could consider about a bed fixed to the floor; it reveals nothing.

text: Who had the bed clamped to the floor?
why: A plain question raised by the clamped bed; the wording names no one.

text: Who had the bed clamped to the floor? — an earlier occupant, for some forgotten reason
id: q.who_clamped=an earlier occupant, for some forgotten reason
why: The house and furnishings are old, so an earlier occupant is a reasonable possibility to consider, and it reveals nothing.

text: When was the bed clamped to the floor?
why: A plain question following Holmes's remark about the bed and his attention to the coincidence of dates.

text: When was the bed clamped to the floor? — about the time the ventilator and the rope were put in
id: q.when_clamped=about the time the ventilator and the rope were put in
why: Holmes has just stressed the coincidence of dates of the ventilator, the cord and the bed's occupant, giving reason to consider this.

text: When was the bed clamped to the floor? — long before those changes
why: The natural alternative possibility, since the story has not said when the bed was clamped.

text: How could anything have reached Julia in a room shut on every side? — a rope runs from just above the opening to the pillow, on a bed that cannot be moved
why: The rope hangs from a hook just above the ventilator opening (¶151), its tassel lies on the pillow (¶142), and the bed is clamped (¶214); the sealed room is established in ¶56.
